title: The OTP Trap: How a Simple Code Led to a ₹50,000 Loss
source: NDTV - Common Financial Frauds in India
story:
Ravi, a college student in Pune, received a call from someone claiming to be from his bank’s fraud department. The caller warned him about an unauthorized transaction and asked him to share an OTP. In panic, Ravi complied. Moments later, ₹50,000 vanished from his account.

Precaution: Never share OTPs. Always verify suspicious calls with the bank's official number. Report immediately.

title: Sextortion Scam: A Flirtatious Chat Turned Nightmare
story:
Ankit, 19, chatted with a stranger on Instagram. She later convinced him to join a video call and encouraged him to undress—secretly recording him. She demanded ₹10,000, threatening to release the video.

Precaution: Avoid engaging with strangers in intimate conversations. Report such blackmail to platforms and via the Cybercrime Portal.

title: The Fake Job Offer: When a Dream Opportunity Becomes a Trap
story:
Priya received an offer letter from a reputed-sounding company. Everything looked legitimate until she was asked to pay ₹2,500 for visa processing. After paying, the company vanished.

Precaution: Real companies don’t charge upfront. Verify jobs through trusted platforms and official websites before paying or sending personal data.

title: The Investment Scam: When Quick Returns Lead to Big Losses
story:
Rahul joined a Telegram group promoting crypto investments. He initially received a small return, then invested more. The group disappeared—with his ₹1 lakh.

Precaution: Avoid schemes with guaranteed returns. Stick to SEBI-regulated platforms and consult financial advisors before investing.
